resource-agent.name: rabbitmq-server-ha
resource-agent.longdesc: Resource agent for RabbitMQ promotes a node, then cluster nodes can join it
resource-agent.shortdesc: Resource agent for RabbitMQ HA cluster

parameter.name: binary
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ binary

parameter.name: ctl
parameter.longdesc: rabbitctl binary

parameter.name: pid_file
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ PID file

parameter.name: log_dir
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ log directory

parameter.name: username
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ user name

parameter.name: groupname
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ group name

parameter.name: admin_user
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ default admin user for API

parameter.name: admin_password
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ default admin user password for API

parameter.name: definitions_dump_file
parameter.longdesc: RabbitMQ default definitions dump file

parameter.name: command_timeout
parameter.longdesc: Timeout command arguments for issued commands termination (value is auto evaluated)

parameter.name: start_time
parameter.longdesc: Timeout for start rabbitmq server

parameter.name: stop_time
parameter.longdesc: Timeout for stopping rabbitmq server

parameter.name: debug
parameter.longdesc: The debug flag for agent (/usr/sbin/rabbitmq-server) instance. In the /tmp/ directory will be created rmq-* files for log some operations and ENV values inside OCF-script.

parameter.name: mnesia_base
parameter.longdesc: Base directory for storing Mnesia files
parameter.shortdesc: Base directory for storing Mnesia files

parameter.name: mnesia_schema_base
parameter.longdesc: Parent directory for Mnesia schema directory
parameter.shortdesc: Parent directory for Mnesia schema directory

parameter.name: host_ip
parameter.longdesc: /usr/sbin/rabbitmq-server should listen on this IP address
parameter.shortdesc: /usr/sbin/rabbitmq-server should listen on this IP address

parameter.name: node_port
parameter.longdesc: /usr/sbin/rabbitmq-server should listen on this port

parameter.name: default_vhost
parameter.longdesc: Default virtual host used for monitoring if a node is fully synchronized with the rest of the cluster. In normal operation, the resource agent will wait for queues from this virtual host on this node to be synchronized elsewhere before stopping RabbitMQ. This also means queues in other virtual hosts may not be fully synchronized on stop operations.
parameter.shortdesc: Default virtual host used for waiting for synchronization

parameter.name: erlang_cookie
parameter.longdesc: Erlang cookie for clustering. If specified, will be updated at the mnesia reset

parameter.name: erlang_cookie_file
parameter.longdesc: Erlang cookie file path where the cookie will be put, if requested

parameter.name: use_fqdn
parameter.longdesc: Either to use FQDN or a shortname for the rabbitmq node

parameter.name: fqdn_prefix
parameter.longdesc: Optional FQDN prefix for RabbitMQ nodes in cluster. FQDN prefix can be specified to host multiple RabbitMQ instances on a node or in case of RabbitMQ running in dedicated network/interface.

parameter.name: max_rabbitmqctl_timeouts
parameter.longdesc: If during monitor call rabbitmqctl times out, the timeout is ignored unless it is Nth timeout in a row. Here N is the value of the current parameter. If too many timeouts happen in a raw, the monitor call will return with error.
parameter.shortdesc: Fail only if that many rabbitmqctl timeouts in a row occurred

parameter.name: policy_file
parameter.longdesc: A path to the shell script to setup RabbitMQ policies

parameter.name: rmq_feature_health_check
parameter.longdesc: Since rabbit 3.6.4 list_queues/list_channels-based monitoring should be replaced with "node_health_check" command, as it creates no network load at all.

parameter.name: rmq_feature_local_list_queues
parameter.longdesc: For rabbit version that implements --local flag for list_queues, this can greatly reduce network overhead in cases when node is stopped/demoted.

parameter.name: limit_nofile
parameter.longdesc: Soft and hard limit for NOFILE

parameter.name: avoid_using_iptables
parameter.longdesc: When set to true the iptables calls to block client access become noops. This is useful when we run inside containers.

parameter.name: allowed_cluster_nodes
parameter.longdesc: When set to anything other than the empty string it must container the list of cluster node names, separated by spaces, where the rabbitmq resource is allowed to run. Tis is needed when rabbitmq is running on a subset of nodes part of a larger cluster. The default ("") is to assume that all nodes part of the cluster will run the rabbitmq resource.
parameter.shortdesc: List of cluster nodes where rabbitmq is allowed to run
